title: Colosseum 1.1.7
summary: Stremio sync, tracker connections, a new Extensions Store, your own history and stats, and redesigned subtitles.

highlights.title: Stremio comes with you
highlights.body: Connect Stremio and your library, progress and watch history come into Colosseum, then keep moving on both sides.

highlights.title: Tracker connections
highlights.body: The Sync Center connects Trakt, Simkl, MyAnimeList and AniList to your profile, separate from Stremio sync.

highlights.title: The Extensions Store
highlights.body: A world of its own: the House, the Essentials and rows from the stremio-addons.net catalogue, with setup kept inside Colosseum.

highlights.title: Your Colosseum
highlights.body: Highlights and stats from what you read, watched and listened to, recorded by Colosseum on this profile.

highlights.title: Subtitles redesigned
highlights.body: New subtitle controls with font selection and a tidier appearance panel.

highlights.title: Continue Watching is back
highlights.body: Continue Watching cards from the IMDb catalogue return, and world text reads better on light wallpapers.
